mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: Explicit buyer-warning thread: poster reports King main thrust bearings made since 2024 are out of spec on free spread, slipping into the cap and block groove with no interference fit and risking a spun thrust main. Poster says King's own technical support advised against using them.
mentions.replyNote: Read successfully: still no King or official reply, thread open and unresolved, most recent post still 3 June 2026 where the poster reports receiving in-spec NOS Clevite thrust bearings.

mentions.title: WARNING!! Check all KING brand bearings before install
mentions.snippet: Buyer-warning thread on the BMW E90 forum: King rod bearing boxes found with mixed sizes, 0.25 shells packed in standard-marked boxes. Readers are told to measure every shell before install.

mentions.title: King Main Bearings Defective
mentions.snippet: BMW M5 builder reports King STDX main sets whose thrust bearings are over 1mm too narrow to fit the block, repeated across more than one S85 block, and concludes King main bearings should not be used on that engine.

mentions.title: Got a set of King SI bearings with a defective bearing...awesome
mentions.snippet: Builder reports a King SI bi-metal main shell malformed in production, crushed and twisted so it would not seat in the block, plus machining shavings found inside the sealed rod bearing packaging.
